desk.prefs.title: Preferences
desk.session.lost: Reload this page to start a new local session.
desk.session.unavailableTitle: The desk server does not answer
desk.session.unavailable: Check that the server still runs, then try again.
desk.toast.title: #{{number}} · {{message}}
desk.error.bad-request: The desk could not read that request.
desk.error.unauthorized: Your session is missing. Open the launch link again.
desk.error.not-found: The server has no such page.
desk.error.method-not-allowed: The server does not allow this method.
desk.error.unsupported-media-type: The server does not accept this content type.
desk.error.busy: Another action of this issue still runs. Wait until it ends.
desk.error.artifact-missing: The issue has not written this file yet.
desk.error.internal: The server had an internal error. Its terminal shows the details.
desk.error.leased: Another desk process drives this issue now.
desk.error.unknown-issue: The desk has no state for this issue.
desk.error.unreadable: The state file of this issue cannot be read.
desk.error.invalid-transition: The issue is not at a stage where this action is allowed.
desk.error.ship-refused: The ship was refused. Nothing was changed.
desk.error.draft-refused: The draft was not applied. The reason is below.
desk.error.refresh-refused: The PR check was refused. The reason is below.
desk.error.pr-refused: Sending the PR feedback was refused. The reason is below.
desk.error.already-started: This issue already started. Use Continue or Remove.
desk.error.intake-refused: Intake refused this issue. The reason is below.
desk.error.authorization: The owner did not authorize this run. Use the override for your own runs.
desk.error.worktree-dirty: The worktree has changes. Tick “Remove even with changes” to force it.
desk.error.remove-failed: The desk could not remove the issue.
desk.error.network: The desk server cannot be reached.
desk.error.invalid-response: The server sent an answer that this page does not understand.
desk.board.title: Issues
desk.board.intro: Every issue the desk knows, grouped by who must act next.
desk.board.empty: Choose “Start issue” and enter the number of a GitHub issue. Its card appears here when intake has read it.
desk.board.noMatch: No issue here matches the search.
desk.board.groupHelp.needs-you: The desk stopped or failed here. Read the reason and decide.
desk.board.groupHelp.waiting: The plan or the pull request waits for your decision.
desk.board.groupHelp.running: An agent or the engine works on these.
desk.board.columnEmpty.waiting: No plan or pull request waits for you.
desk.board.columnEmpty.done: Shipped and cancelled issues appear here.
desk.start.title: Start an issue
desk.start.numberHelp: The number of a GitHub issue of this repository.
desk.start.overrideHelp: Normally the owner's ready-for-agent label starts a run. The override skips that check for your own runs. The desk logs it in the status comment.
desk.issue.unreadable: The state of this issue cannot be read. The desk shows the raw reason and does not guess.
desk.build.claimed: Checks the builder says it ran
desk.build.claimedHint: These are claims. The engine's own check report decides.
desk.check.drift: Generated files changed during the check. Run the generator and review the diff.
desk.review.rejected: Findings dropped because they point outside the diff: {{count}}
desk.diff.title: Changes
desk.diff.clipped: Only the first {{lines}} lines are shown.
desk.artifact.missing: The issue has not written this yet.
desk.flow.title: Pipeline
desk.flow.nodeHint: Press Enter to show this stage in the inspector.
desk.flow.fitView: Fit the graph to the view
desk.gate.intro.plan-gate: The planner wrote a plan. Approve it to start the build, or send feedback to plan again.
desk.gate.intro.pr-review: The build, the checks, and the review are done. Send feedback to a stage, or ship. Shipping opens a draft pull request.
desk.gate.intro.pr-open: The draft pull request is open. Review it and merge it on GitHub. Then check the PR here, and the desk records the result.
desk.gate.intro.needs-you: The desk stopped and kept the stage to resume. Read the reason, fix the cause, then continue.
desk.gate.intro.working: An agent or the engine runs now. Controls that start work return when it ends.
desk.gate.intro.shipped: The pull request is merged. The desk saw the merge when you checked the PR.
desk.gate.intro.cancelled: This run was cancelled. Remove it to clean up the worktree.
desk.gate.intro.idle: The issue waits. Nothing runs now.
desk.gate.ready.title: Ship readiness
desk.gate.ready.sameDiff: The review saw the checked code
desk.gate.working.label: Working at: {{stage}}
desk.gate.prOpen.youMerge: You merge it yourself. The desk never merges, approves, or turns on auto-merge.
desk.gate.cancel.title: Cancel this run?
desk.gate.cancel.description: The desk stops the agent now. The worktree and the branch stay.
desk.gate.remove.title: Remove this issue?
desk.gate.remove.description: This deletes the desk state and the worktree of the issue. The branch stays.
desk.gate.remove.forceHelp: Without this box the desk refuses to remove a worktree that has uncommitted changes.
desk.action.done.approve: Plan approved. The build, the checks, and the review ran.
desk.action.done.feedback: Feedback sent. The stage ran again.
desk.action.done.continue: Continued. The run ended at its next stop.
desk.action.done.pr-feedback: PR feedback sent. Build, checks, and review ran again.
desk.action.accepted.start: Started. It runs in the background. The issue appears on the board when intake has written its state.
desk.action.accepted.continue: Continued. The run goes on in the background.
desk.action.accepted.refresh-pr: Checking the PR. The result comes in the background.
desk.action.unknown: The live connection dropped while this action ran. Reload the issue to see its result.
desk.feedback.label: Feedback
desk.prFeedback.intro: The desk reads the failing checks and the review comments of trusted accounts on the PR head, and sends them to build. Text from other accounts never reaches the builder.
desk.prFeedback.label: Your note for the builder (optional)
desk.ship.title: Ship to a draft pull request
desk.ship.step.checking: Step 1 of 2: the desk checks what a ship would do. Nothing changes.
desk.ship.step.review: Step 1 of 2: read the dry run.
desk.ship.gateFailed: These rules block the ship. Fix them first.
desk.ship.draft: A draft against main. The desk never merges it.
desk.ship.updatesPr: Pushes to PR #{{pr}}. Its title and text stay as they are.
desk.ship.noFiles: The commit would hold no files.
desk.ship.confirmText: This commits {{count}} files on {{branch}}, pushes the branch, and opens a draft pull request.
desk.ship.updateText: This commits {{count}} files on {{branch}} and pushes to PR #{{pr}}. It never forces the push and opens no new pull request.
desk.ship.youMerge: You merge it yourself. The desk never merges.
desk.ship.shipping: Committing, pushing, and opening the pull request
desk.ship.done: Shipped. The draft pull request is open.
desk.ship.updated: Pushed. PR #{{pr}} has the new commit.
desk.log.title: Live log
desk.log.label: Log of this issue
desk.health.title: Health
desk.health.intro: What the desk needs on this machine and whether each part works.
desk.issue.copyFailed: The browser did not allow copying.
desk.inspector.title: Selected stage
desk.inspector.anomaly.denials: Tool calls blocked by the permission rules: {{count}}
desk.inspector.anomaly.sameFailure: The same check failure came back. The engine stopped early.
desk.activity.title: Activity
desk.activity.label: History of this issue
desk.activity.event.pr-updated: PR updated with a new commit
desk.stats.title: Agent runs
desk.stats.intro: Every agent run, compared by role, provider, and model.
desk.stats.empty: No agent runs recorded yet. Every agent run adds one record.
desk.stats.groupsHint: Means are per run. Change the model of one role at a time, then compare the rows.
desk.stats.invalidLines: {{count}} line(s) of runs.jsonl could not be read and were skipped.
desk.lessons.title: Lesson candidates
desk.lessons.empty: No problem seen in {{count}} or more issues yet.
desk.lessons.hint: Each row was seen in {{count}} or more issues. “Now” counts the times under the current instructions. Promote a lesson with the kaine-encode-knowledge skill. The desk never puts a lesson into a prompt.
desk.lessons.belowThreshold: Other kinds of problem, seen in fewer issues: {{count}}
desk.lessons.invalidLines: {{count}} line(s) of lessons.jsonl could not be read and were skipped.
desk.inspector.usage.title: Agent usage, all runs
desk.health.copied: Command copied. Run it in a terminal.
desk.health.copyFailed: The browser did not allow the copy. Select the command and copy it.
desk.health.fix.started: The repair runs. The page updates when it ends.
desk.health.fix.description.docker-build: The desk runs pnpm desk docker build. The first build takes a few minutes and about 2 GB. No agent runs.
desk.picker.title: Open issues on GitHub
desk.picker.empty: The repository has no open issues.
desk.picker.noMatch: No open issue matches the filter.
desk.picker.needsOverride: #{{number}} has no ready-for-agent label. Check the override to run it on your own authority, or label it on GitHub first.
desk.pulls.title: Open pull requests
desk.pulls.intro: Read-only. The desk opens draft pull requests for its own issues and does not continue a pull request. Review and merge on GitHub.
desk.pulls.empty: The repository has no open pull requests.
desk.gate.needsYou.restartHelp: Intake reads the issue again from GitHub. Fix the issue there first: the format is in docs/agents/issue-format.md, and pnpm desk contract shows how intake reads it. Check the override only for your own run of an issue without the ready label.
desk.action.done.apply-draft: The issue body on GitHub is the draft now. Start the issue again.
desk.draft.help: A read-only agent sorts the issue's facts into the six sections. Nothing reaches GitHub until you apply the draft.
desk.draft.title: Draft of #{{number}}
desk.draft.intro: The issue in the format the desk reads. The old text stays at the end as a quote.
desk.draft.confirmText: Replace the body of #{{number}} on GitHub with this draft? The old text stays at the end as a quote. The desk refuses when someone changed the issue after the draft.
